title: Constraining Scale-Dependent Growth in f(R) Gravity with Future 21 cm Surveys
efc_relevance: Forecasts for 21-cm scale-dependent growth signatures in f(R); the forecast methodology transfers directly to EFC's µ(k, z) and Σ(k, z) predictions and gives a concrete Stage-IV detectability template ahead of SKA / HIRAX.
ledger_action: Add to Stage-IV Roadmap as forecast-methodology import; cross-reference framework:fR-Starobinsky2007 and gap theory-efclass-boltzmann-solver; required follow-up: re-cast forecast pipeline with EFC perturbation predictions.
